name: Denmark
summary: Scandinavian peninsula and archipelagic nation. Pioneer of modern commercial wind energy engineering with majority power generated from integrated North Sea and Baltic wind turbines.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 1.68x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); clean North Sea coastal airflow limits particulate stagnation.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; DMI recorded warmest average temperature in Danish records.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear least-squares warming trend across Danish stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.07% share of global emissions; down 65% from 1990 baseline levels.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Well below OECD average; district heating networks converted to heat pumps and sustainable biomass.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Woodland coverage ~6,700 km²; national target of 20-25% forest cover by end of century.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Global wind leader: wind turbines provided 58.2%, bioenergy 19.8%, and solar PV 9.2% of grid power.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 139 people/km²; urban population fraction is 88.2%.
